lines: Of those seven powers, by their difference
up to the earth-and-rest principal tattva: each
its own form by fourteen differences —
l4.sanskrit_cite: eṣāṃ saptaiva śaktayaḥ tadbhedāt pṛthivyādipradhānatattvāntaṃ caturdaśabhir bhedaiḥ pratyekaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ pañcadaśam
